articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a larger effective context window. The model demonstrates step-change improvements on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex agentic coding tasks, raising the bar for frontier model capabilities.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Pro Tops Agentic Coding and Research Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released updated Gemini 2.5 Pro checkpoints that lead on SWE-bench Verified and several multi-step research benchmarks. The model introduces improved tool-use orchestration and a refined thinking budget mechanism that lets developers trade latency for accuracy, making it particularly effective for autonomous software engineering pipelines.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 02 Humanoids in BMW Plants
articles.summary: Figure announced the start of paid commercial operations with its Figure 02 humanoid robots at BMW's Spartanburg manufacturing facility, marking one of the first scaled deployments of general-purpose humanoids in automotive production. The robots handle bin-picking, part insertion, and inter-station transport tasks using on-board vision-language-action models fine-tuned for factory workflows.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Prototype Demonstrates Fluid Bipedal Walking and Dexterous Manipulation
articles.summary: Tesla showed a new Optimus Gen 3 prototype with redesigned actuators achieving smoother, more human-like gait on uneven terrain and improved hand dexterity for handling small objects. The demo included the robot autonomously sorting mixed warehouse inventory, signaling Tesla's intent to begin limited internal deployment later this year.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Persistent Memory and Sandboxed Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic rolled out a new agentic framework for Claude that supports persistent cross-session memory, sandboxed code execution, and structured multi-step tool orchestration via a new API surface. The system targets enterprise automation workflows and includes built-in safety monitoring that can pause agent chains when confidence drops below configurable thresholds.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm N2 Process Node for Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed high-volume manufacturing of its N2 process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, with first customer shipments expected in Q3 2026. The node delivers roughly 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N3E, and is expected to power the next generation of AI training and inference chips from Apple, Nvidia, and AMD.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Reliable Logical Qubit Operations Below Error-Correction Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained logical qubit operations with error rates below the fault-tolerance threshold across a 56-physical-qubit trapped-ion system. The milestone validates their hybrid classical-quantum error correction scheme and brings practical quantum advantage for certain chemistry and optimization problems meaningfully closer.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Maverick Open-Weight Model Rivaling Closed Frontier Systems
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Maverick, an open-weight mixture-of-experts model with 128 experts and 17B active parameters per forward pass, achieving performance competitive with GPT-4.5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro on reasoning and coding benchmarks. The release includes optimized inference kernels for consumer GPUs, further democratizing access to frontier-class language model capabilities.
